{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model-reversed trends catch up",
    "Sentiment momentum is stronger than current sentiment levels, showing delayed reaction to shifting market psychology",
    "Model tends to overshoot mean reversion targets when prices are far from forecast baseline, especially in uptrends",
    "Sentiment alignment with price direction breaks down during consolidation, causing forecast divergence",
    "Lag magnitude correlates with price change velocity, faster moves => longer model lag",
    "Model uses linear interpolation between historical points while true outcomes exhibit more nonlinear reversion to recently traded levels"
] }
